column1: # Local commit -> commit in the public artifact (github shadi97kh/rna-identifiability).
# The artifact keeps only the code and results the paper uses, everywhere in its history
# (artifact/keep_files.txt, artifact/keep_runs.txt), so EVERY commit was rewritten: the
# git_sha a run artifact records is the local commit, and this map gives the artifact
# commit carrying its code. 'dropped' marks a local commit that touched only excluded
# paths; it maps to the artifact commit that already carried everything it kept. Built by
# artifact/export.sh and artifact/commit_map.py; the commit adding this file is not in it.
